verdict.summary: The change correctly makes each malformed flow.target_ci_queue container or row visible through a bounded, independently budgeted diagnostic while preserving the existing tolerant row-drop behavior and surviving valid rows. Repository text is sanitized and capped before logging, type-only diagnostics do not expose collector values, and the hoisted regex preserves the prior accepted shape. The self-tests use literal inputs and expectations, exercise container, row, repository, depth, sanitization, suppression, independence, valid, absent, and mixed-row paths, and retain full diagnostic ordering so the assertions are non-vacuous. No trust check is weakened and no default-allow path is introduced.
